_comment: Golden vocabulary vectors for the Data Model authoring surface (schema-bundle design §2, tier 2). One checked-in dataset judged by BOTH the Python suite (tests/test_data_models_vocabulary.py, against CANONICAL_DATA_TYPES) and colca's Go suite (plugins/uns/exec_edit_model_test.go, against slotDataTypes), so the two native copies of the slot data_type vocabulary can never drift apart silently.
